roadmap.title: First playthrough and chapter objectives
roadmap.description: Play Chapters 1–14 on any difficulty. Learn the core combat systems, complete convenient exploration, and secure the Chapter 4 parade, Chapter 5 tournament, and Chapter 12 LOVELESS objectives; Chapter Select preserves progress and allows retries.

roadmap.title: World Intel and regional protorelics
roadmap.description: Use Chapter 13 free roam or Chapter Select to complete all 169 World Intel objectives, every regional Phenomenon Intel chain, Gilgamesh Island, all Moogle Intel, and Chadley's full materia inventory.

roadmap.title: Quests, minigames, and Johnny's hotel
roadmap.description: Finish all 36 side quests, Gold Saucer activities, six piano songs, and every Treasure Trove source. Collect all 88 unique items and report to Johnny.

roadmap.title: Postgame character mastery
roadmap.description: Reach level 70, create a 300% stagger multiplier, master all 49 weapon abilities, and buy every required non-blue folio ability and limit break.

roadmap.title: Hard difficulty chapters
roadmap.description: Use the postgame Chapter Select menu to clear Chapters 1–14 on Hard with the developed party and mastered materia.

roadmap.title: Combat Simulator finale
roadmap.description: Complete every remaining Chadley Combat Simulator bout, including the postgame Brutal and Legendary challenges, then collect the all-achievement award.

achievements.description: Earn all FINAL FANTASY VII REBIRTH achievements.
achievements.sortReason: Placed in the route phase where its requirements can be completed efficiently.
achievements.summary: Unlock every other one of the 60 Steam achievements for FINAL FANTASY VII REBIRTH.

guide.context: This meta achievement is automatic; it normally follows the Hard chapter clear and the final Chadley Combat Simulator challenge.

steps.text: Finish all story, combat, exploration, minigame, quest, Treasure Trove, Hard-mode, and Combat Simulator achievements.
After the sixtieth non-meta achievement registers, remain in-game until The Planet's Hope appears.

achievements.description: Win a battle.
achievements.sortReason: Placed in the route phase where its requirements can be completed efficiently.
achievements.summary: Win any combat encounter; the first post-prologue Insectoid Chimera group in @loc{Chapter 1} is the earliest opportunity.

guide.context: Any victory counts, so this should unlock naturally before the first boss.

steps.text: Defeat every enemy in one combat encounter and remain in the field until the victory state completes.

achievements.description: Exploit an enemy's weakness.
achievements.sortReason: Placed in the route phase where its requirements can be completed efficiently.
achievements.summary: Assess an enemy, then hit the elemental weakness listed in its combat information.

guide.context: Assess materia is sold by the vending machine at Bill's Ranch in Chapter 2; the weakness also appears in Command Menu ability information after assessment.

steps.text: Equip @item{Assess materia} and use Assess on an enemy.
Cast or use an attack matching the listed elemental weakness before the battle ends.

achievements.description: Free a bound ally.
achievements.sortReason: Placed in the route phase where its requirements can be completed efficiently.
achievements.summary: In the @enemy{Materia Guardian} fight, attack the hindleg that binds a party member until the ally is freed.

guide.context: The Chapter 1 boss uses a binding hindleg attack during its scripted combat sequence, giving a repeatable release opportunity if the grabbed ally is not freed immediately.

steps.text: Wait for @enemy{Materia Guardian} to seize Cloud or Sephiroth with a hindleg.
Target and damage the binding hindleg until the captured party member returns to combat.

achievements.description: Stagger an enemy.
achievements.sortReason: Placed in the route phase where its requirements can be completed efficiently.
achievements.summary: Fill any enemy's orange stagger gauge and trigger @mechanic{Staggered}.

guide.context: Pressure conditions accelerate the orange gauge, but ordinary attacks against the early Chapter 1 Insectoid Chimeras are enough.

steps.text: Attack a single enemy until its orange gauge fills completely and the @mechanic{Staggered} status appears.

achievements.description: Use a limit break.
achievements.sortReason: Placed in the route phase where its requirements can be completed efficiently.
achievements.summary: Fill a character's Limit gauge and execute any action from @mechanic{Command Menu > Limit}.

guide.context: Taking damage and staggering enemies fill the yellow Limit gauge; the command remains unavailable until the gauge is full.

steps.text: Fight until one active character's yellow Limit gauge is full.
Open @mechanic{Command Menu > Limit} and confirm any available limit break.

achievements.description: Invoke a summon.
achievements.sortReason: Placed in the route phase where its requirements can be completed efficiently.
achievements.summary: Equip summon materia, fill the purple Summon gauge in an eligible battle, and invoke the summon.

guide.context: Summons are limited to qualifying longer encounters, and the command also needs the displayed ATB cost.

steps.text: Equip any @item{summon materia} before a qualifying battle.
When the purple gauge fills, build the required ATB and choose the summon from the Command Menu.

achievements.description: Use a synergy skill.
achievements.sortReason: Placed in the route phase where its requirements can be completed efficiently.
achievements.summary: Use any displayed synergy skill by holding the guard/synergy input and selecting a partner action.

guide.context: Cloud and Sephiroth can perform the first eligible synergy skill during Chapter 1's initial two-party battle.

steps.text: Hold the guard/synergy input during a two-character battle, then activate any displayed partner skill.

achievements.description: Use a synergy ability.
achievements.sortReason: Placed in the route phase where its requirements can be completed efficiently.
achievements.summary: Build two partners' synergy charges with marked ATB commands, then execute one paired Synergy Ability.

guide.context: The Chapter 1 Materia Guardian tutorial supplies an early guided opportunity once both partners have enough synergy pips.

steps.text: Spend ATB on abilities marked with the synergy icon for both participating characters.
Choose @mechanic{Command Menu > Synergy Abilities} and execute an available paired attack.

achievements.description: Complete a quest.
achievements.sortReason: Placed in the route phase where its requirements can be completed efficiently.
achievements.summary: Complete any green-icon side quest, such as @loc{Flowers from the Hill} at Bill's Ranch.

guide.context: Side quests begin in Chapter 2 and remain available for cleanup through Chapter Select.

steps.text: Speak to Chloe at @loc{Bill's Ranch} and accept @loc{Flowers from the Hill}.
At @loc{Wildflower Plateau}, defeat the Mandragoras and collect one red, one yellow, and one white flower cluster.
Return all three flower clusters to Chloe to complete the quest.

achievements.description: Max out a weapon ability's proficiency.
achievements.sortReason: Placed in the route phase where its requirements can be completed efficiently.
achievements.summary: Reach 100% proficiency with one weapon ability, such as Cloud's @mechanic{Focused Thrust} from the Buster Sword.

guide.context: Every weapon lists a Proficiency Bonus condition that accelerates mastery; the ability remains permanently learned at 100%.

steps.text: Equip Cloud's @item{Buster Sword} and place @mechanic{Focused Thrust} on the command list.
Use Focused Thrust as the hit that staggers enemies until its proficiency meter reaches 100%.

achievements.description: Level up an orb of materia.
achievements.sortReason: Placed in the route phase where its requirements can be completed efficiently.
achievements.summary: Earn enough battle AP for any equipped materia to gain one star.

guide.context: Materia receives AP after victorious battles even when its spell or command is never used.

steps.text: Place any non-mastered materia in an active weapon or armor slot.
Win battles until the materia's AP threshold fills and its star level increases.

achievements.description: Raise your Queen's Blood rank.
achievements.sortReason: Placed in the route phase where its requirements can be completed efficiently.
achievements.summary: Defeat @enemy{Ned}, @enemy{Nene}, and @enemy{Zahira} at Queen's Blood in Kalm to reach rank 2.

guide.context: These three Chapter 2 opponents are available before leaving Kalm and provide the first rank promotion.

steps.text: Beat Ned at the Queen's Blood board beside Kalm's tavern.
Beat Nene at the board beside the southeastern stairs.
Beat Zahira at the northeastern corner of Kalm.

achievements.description: Complete your search of a cache location.
achievements.sortReason: Placed in the route phase where its requirements can be completed efficiently.
achievements.summary: Open both labeled cache chests at @loc{Thresher Waterwheel}, east of Kalm.

guide.context: A cache completes only when every chest named by its on-screen counter is opened.

steps.text: Travel east of Kalm to @loc{Thresher Waterwheel} and enter beneath the wooden wheel.
Open both marked treasure chests around the waterwheel until the cache counter is complete.

achievements.description: Repair three chocobo stops.
achievements.sortReason: Placed in the route phase where its requirements can be completed efficiently.
achievements.summary: Raise the fallen signs at three blue-sign chocobo stops in the Grasslands.

guide.context: Chocobo chicks lead toward nearby stops, and repaired stops become fast-travel/rest points.

steps.text: Repair the stop on the road north of @loc{Bill's Ranch}.
Repair the stop beside the eastern marsh road.
Repair the stop on the western road toward @loc{Kalm}.

achievements.description: Use a chocobo to find two treasures buried by rabbits.
achievements.sortReason: Placed in the route phase where its requirements can be completed efficiently.
achievements.summary: Follow two blue scent trails while riding a chocobo and dig up the buried rabbit treasures.

guide.context: The Grasslands road north of Bill's Ranch and the southeastern road above the swamp provide early opportunities.

steps.text: Mount Piko, hold the scent input at a blue question-mark ping, rotate toward the trail, follow it to the endpoint, and dig.
Repeat the full scent-trail and digging sequence at a second blue question-mark ping.

achievements.description: Defeat a summon in battle and obtain its materia.
achievements.sortReason: Placed in the route phase where its requirements can be completed efficiently.
achievements.summary: Defeat any summon in @mechanic{Chadley's Combat Simulator}, such as Titan in the Grasslands.

guide.context: Matching Divine Intel shrines weaken a summon without changing achievement eligibility; completing all three Titan shrines gives the easiest version.

steps.text: Complete one or more @loc{Grasslands Divine Intel} crystal-memory shrines to weaken Titan.
At Chadley, select @mechanic{Combat Simulator > Summons > Summon Entity: Titan}, defeat Titan, and claim its materia.

achievements.description: Gather world intel at five separate locations.
achievements.sortReason: Placed in the route phase where its requirements can be completed efficiently.
achievements.summary: Complete any five World Intel objectives on regional maps.

guide.context: Towers, lifesprings, fiend hunts, summon shrines, excavations, Moogle Intel, and Phenomenon Intel all add to the same counter.

steps.text: Open the Grasslands map and complete any five orange World Intel icons; activating the first four towers plus one nearby fiend or lifespring is sufficient.

achievements.description: Gather world intel at fifty separate locations.
achievements.sortReason: Placed in the route phase where its requirements can be completed efficiently.
achievements.summary: Complete 50 of the game's 169 World Intel objectives across any regions.

guide.context: World Intel progress is permanent across Chapter Select and does not require finishing a region before moving on.

steps.text: Clear orange World Intel icons in the Grasslands, Junon, and later regions until Chadley's counter reaches 50.

achievements.description: Gather all pieces of world intel in a region.
achievements.sortReason: Placed in the route phase where its requirements can be completed efficiently.
achievements.summary: Complete all 30 World Intel objectives in the @loc{Grasslands}.

guide.context: The Grasslands set contains one chocobo objective, six towers, six fiend hunts, three divine shrines, six lifesprings, two excavations, one classified hunt, one Moogle Intel, and four Phenomenon Intel entries.

steps.text: Open the Grasslands World Intel map and clear every remaining orange icon in each category.
Confirm the regional map displays 30/30 completed objectives.

achievements.description: Complete the Grasslands protorelic storyline.
achievements.sortReason: Placed in the route phase where its requirements can be completed efficiently.
achievements.summary: Finish all four Grasslands Phenomenon Intel assignments and collect the protorelic from Beck's gang.

guide.context: The fourth assignment appears only after the first three Wild Bandit Chase entries are complete.

steps.text: Complete Grasslands Phenomenon Intel 1–3 by pursuing Beck's Badasses through their marked hideouts.
At Phenomenon Intel 4 east of Kalm, unlock the production-hall gate, pull the front-right lever, defeat or pay the gang, and take the protorelic.

achievements.description: Complete the Junon protorelic storyline.
achievements.sortReason: Placed in the route phase where its requirements can be completed efficiently.
achievements.summary: Clear all four Fort Condor stages in Junon's Phenomenon Intel chain.

guide.context: Standard Fort Condor difficulty awards the achievement; the Hard rematches are only needed later for Johnny's Treasure Trove.

steps.text: Visit Junon Phenomenon Intel 1–4 in order and win each Fort Condor board on standard difficulty.
Complete Stage 4 at the northeastern valley ruin to finish the protorelic storyline.

achievements.description: Complete the Corel protorelic storyline.
achievements.sortReason: Placed in the route phase where its requirements can be completed efficiently.
achievements.summary: Complete all four Corel Phenomenon Intel entries and their Cactuar Crush stages.

guide.context: Aerith and Yuffie receive separate score challenges during this regional protorelic story; the normal objective thresholds are enough for the achievement.

steps.text: Follow Corel Phenomenon Intel 1–4 in order and clear every required Cactuar Crush stage with the assigned character.
Finish the fourth entry and receive Corel's protorelic.

achievements.description: Complete the Gongaga protorelic storyline.
achievements.sortReason: Placed in the route phase where its requirements can be completed efficiently.
achievements.summary: Finish all four Gongaga Phenomenon Intel assignments in the Turks training storyline.

guide.context: Each entry unlocks the next marked Gongaga training site, and the fourth encounter closes the regional chain.

steps.text: Travel to Gongaga Phenomenon Intel 1–4 in order and complete every Turks combat exercise.
Win the final training encounter and collect the Gongaga protorelic.

achievements.description: Complete the Cosmo Canyon protorelic storyline.
achievements.sortReason: Placed in the route phase where its requirements can be completed efficiently.
achievements.summary: Clear all four Cosmo Canyon Phenomenon Intel entries and finish Gears and Gambits.

guide.context: The robots must be configured to exploit each enemy wave; only the standard four-stage storyline is required here.

steps.text: Visit Cosmo Canyon Phenomenon Intel 1–4 and configure the supplied robots to defeat every standard Gears and Gambits wave.
Clear the fourth stage to receive the Cosmo Canyon protorelic.

achievements.description: Complete the Nibel protorelic storyline.
achievements.sortReason: Placed in the route phase where its requirements can be completed efficiently.
achievements.summary: Complete all four Nibel Phenomenon Intel entries and finish the robed-men storyline.

guide.context: The four assignments are marked as the region opens and must be cleared in sequence.

steps.text: Visit Nibel Phenomenon Intel 1–4, complete each robed-man handling objective, and win the associated encounters.
Complete the fourth assignment and receive the Nibel protorelic.

achievements.description: Defeat the legendary swordsman on Gilgamesh Island.
achievements.sortReason: Placed in the route phase where its requirements can be completed efficiently.
achievements.summary: Complete all six regional protorelic chains, finish Gilgamesh Island's four battles, and defeat @enemy{Gilgamesh}.

guide.context: Gilgamesh Island appears northeast of the Meridian Ocean during Chapter 13 only after the Grasslands, Junon, Corel, Gongaga, Cosmo Canyon, and Nibel protorelics are secured.

steps.text: Complete Phenomenon Intel 1–4 in all six mainland regions.
After Chadley's call, sail the Tiny Bronco to @loc{Gilgamesh Island} northeast of the Meridian Ocean.
Clear the island's first three Phenomenon Intel superboss battles.
Enter the fourth Phenomenon Intel arena and defeat @enemy{Gilgamesh}.

achievements.description: Max out your moogle emporium merchant rank.
achievements.sortReason: Placed in the route phase where its requirements can be completed efficiently.
achievements.summary: Complete all seven Moogle Intel challenges across six regions; Corel contains two challenges.

guide.context: Later Moogle Emporiums add moving hazards, but every stage has the same goal: herd every mooglet through the central gate before time expires.

steps.text: Clear one Moogle Intel mushroom house in Grasslands, one in Junon, two in Corel, one in Gongaga, one in Cosmo Canyon, and one in Nibel.

achievements.description: Develop all possible materia together with Chadley.
achievements.sortReason: Placed in the route phase where its requirements can be completed efficiently.
achievements.summary: Complete all 169 World Intel objectives, then develop every materia and duplicate offered by Chadley.

guide.context: The inventory expands with regional data and Gilgamesh Island completion. The requirement is every purchasable copy, not merely one copy of each materia name.

steps.text: Complete every World Intel icon in the six mainland regions and all four Gilgamesh Island Phenomenon Intel battles.
Visit Chadley, open @mechanic{Develop Materia}, and spend regional data on every remaining materia copy until no offered stock remains.

achievements.description: Recruit every Seventh Infantry unit in Junon.
achievements.sortReason: Placed in the route phase where its requirements can be completed efficiently.
achievements.summary: Recruit all ten Seventh Infantry units in @loc{Larboard Junon} before reporting for the Chapter 4 parade.

guide.context: The story asks for five units, but the achievement requires all ten. The Rufus-cutout unit also supplies a Treasure Trove photo when framed correctly.

steps.text: Recruit the unit on the platform left of the starting room and the unit posing beside the Rufus cutout on the right street.
Recruit the units inside @loc{Full Arsenal}, the @loc{Glabrescent Bar} back door, @loc{Cecilia's shop}, and @loc{Maghnata Books} floor 3.
Recruit the units in the Barracks Assembly Room and upstairs Briefing Room.
Recruit the unit upstairs in @loc{Le Sourire} and the unit downstairs in the @loc{Larboard Garrison Storeroom}.
Verify the objective shows 10/10, then report for parade formation.

achievements.description: Earn an outstanding approval rating in the Junon parade.
achievements.sortReason: Placed in the route phase where its requirements can be completed efficiently.
achievements.summary: Score more than 100,000 Likes during the Chapter 4 Junon parade.

guide.context: A formation of two Grenadiers, Flametroopers, and two Riot Troopers creates three three-star routines. Chapter Select and a manual save before formation permit retries.

steps.text: Select 2 Grenadiers, 1 Flametrooper unit, and 2 Riot Trooper units for the parade.
Hit nearly every timing prompt as its outline reaches the center and finish with at least 100,000 Likes.

achievements.description: Win the Queen's Blood tournament aboard the Shinra-8.
achievements.sortReason: Placed in the route phase where its requirements can be completed efficiently.
achievements.summary: Win all five rounds of the Chapter 5 Queen's Blood tournament aboard the @loc{Shinra-8}.

guide.context: A loss can be retried before reporting the tournament result, so do not withdraw from the event. The final required opponents are Chadley and Regina.

steps.text: Register at the Shinra-8 tournament desk and remain entered.
Win the first three bracket rounds, retrying any loss before reporting it.
Defeat @enemy{Chadley} and then @enemy{Regina}; complete the Red XIII exhibition when it appears.

achievements.description: Earn an S rank for your performance in LOVELESS.
achievements.sortReason: Placed in the route phase where its requirements can be completed efficiently.
achievements.summary: Earn S rank in the Chapter 12 @loc{LOVELESS} performance at Event Square.

guide.context: Dialogue and branch selections do not block S rank; only the accumulated timed-button ratings matter. Make a manual save before the performance or replay Chapter 12.

steps.text: At @loc{Gold Saucer > Event Square}, hit the displayed LOVELESS prompts accurately enough to maintain high scene ratings.
Finish the full performance and receive an @mechanic{S} result on the score screen.

achievements.description: Donate 10 items to Johnny's Treasure Trove.
achievements.sortReason: Placed in the route phase where its requirements can be completed efficiently.
achievements.summary: Earn and auto-donate 10 unique items to @loc{Johnny's Treasure Trove}.

guide.context: The hotel opens through The Saga of the Seaside Inn, begun in Chapter 7 and completed in Chapter 9; qualifying awards auto-donate when earned.

steps.text: Start @loc{The Saga of the Seaside Inn} in Chapter 7 and finish it after reaching Chapter 9.
Earn maximum-rank minigame, quest, and chapter awards until Johnny's counter reaches 10/88.

achievements.description: Donate 30 items to Johnny's Treasure Trove.
achievements.sortReason: Placed in the route phase where its requirements can be completed efficiently.
achievements.summary: Earn and auto-donate 30 unique items to @loc{Johnny's Treasure Trove}.

guide.context: The same persistent hotel counter includes regional minigames, Gold Saucer activities, and chapter performance awards.

steps.text: Continue earning unique Treasure Trove awards and verify Johnny's hotel counter reaches 30/88.

achievements.description: Donate 60 items to Johnny's Treasure Trove.
achievements.sortReason: Placed in the route phase where its requirements can be completed efficiently.
achievements.summary: Earn and auto-donate 60 unique items to @loc{Johnny's Treasure Trove}.

guide.context: Treasure progress survives Chapter Select, so chapter-specific awards can be recovered without resetting the hotel total.

steps.text: Complete advanced minigame ranks, side-quest challenges, and postgame activities until the hotel counter reaches 60/88.

achievements.description: Donate all 88 items to Johnny's Treasure Trove and speak to Johnny.
achievements.sortReason: Placed in the route phase where its requirements can be completed efficiently.
achievements.summary: Collect all 88 unique Treasure Trove items, then speak to Johnny at his Costa del Sol hotel.

guide.context: The Saga of the Seaside Inn opens the persistent hotel counter. Qualifying awards auto-donate; chapter-specific misses can be recovered with Chapter Select, and the final achievement is awarded only after speaking to Johnny.

collectibles.name: Hustle de Chocobo
collectibles.method: At Bill's Ranch, Grasslands, beat the displayed Rank III target time.

collectibles.name: Glide de Chocobo
collectibles.method: At Cosmo Canyon, earn Rank III on the required course during Bonds of Trust.

collectibles.name: Jumpfrog and Ribbiting Rollers
collectibles.method: At Under Junon, earn the top reward in both frog minigames.

collectibles.name: Dolphin Show
collectibles.method: At Under Junon, finish the replay in under 1:40.

collectibles.name: Fort Condor Hard
collectibles.method: At Junon Phenomenon Intel, clear all four Hard Mode boards.

collectibles.name: Junon parade awards
collectibles.method: At Chapter 4 Larboard Junon, exceed 100,000 Likes and keep all five recruited troopers alive through Roche.

collectibles.name: Queen's Blood tournament
collectibles.method: At Chapter 5 Shinra-8, win the full five-round tournament.

collectibles.name: Pirate's Rampage
collectibles.method: At Costa del Sol, earn Rank III in Brigantine and Ghost Ship.

collectibles.name: Card Carnival
collectibles.method: At Costa del Sol, complete every puzzle challenge and claim all four awards.

collectibles.name: Run Wild
collectibles.method: At Costa del Sol, earn Rank III in Free-for-All and Time Trial.

collectibles.name: Crunch-Off
collectibles.method: At Corel Gym, earn Rank III in the sit-up challenge.

collectibles.name: G-Bike
collectibles.method: At Gold Saucer, earn Rank III on standard and expert courses.

collectibles.name: 3D Brawler
collectibles.method: At Gold Saucer, defeat the opponents that award treasures, including Sephiroth.

collectibles.name: Galactic Saviors
collectibles.method: At Gold Saucer, earn Rank III on standard and expert.

collectibles.name: Chocobo racing
collectibles.method: At Gold Saucer, win every required cup and final race for all four awards.

collectibles.name: Queen's Blood challenges
collectibles.method: At Gold Saucer Wonderment Square, clear the three treasure-awarding boards.

collectibles.name: Musclehead Colosseum
collectibles.method: At Gold Saucer, clear every bout, including postgame bouts, for four awards.

collectibles.name: LOVELESS cast awards
collectibles.method: At Chapter 12 Event Square, earn S rank, then use System > Extra Settings and replay dates with Tifa and Yuffie to complete the seven-award set.

collectibles.name: Desert Rush
collectibles.method: At Dustbowl, earn Rank III on standard and challenging.

collectibles.name: Beast Battleground
collectibles.method: At Dustbowl, clear every treasure-awarding battle set.

collectibles.name: Sand and Circuses
collectibles.method: At Dustbowl side quest, complete the full combat sequence.

collectibles.name: Cactuar Crush
collectibles.method: At Corel Phenomenon Intel, clear the normal and Hard requirements for both awards.

collectibles.name: Gears and Gambits Hard
collectibles.method: At Cosmo Canyon Phenomenon Intel, clear all Hard Mode robot stages.

collectibles.name: Shinra Manor simulations
collectibles.method: At Nibelheim, during Lament of the Damned, clear the four required and four additional simulations.

collectibles.name: Chadley final awards
collectibles.method: At Combat Simulator, clear the treasure-awarding Brutal and Legendary challenge sets.

collectibles.name: Piano Outreach
collectibles.method: At Six regional pianos, earn A rank on all six songs and report to Dorian.

collectibles.name: Snaps scenic photos
collectibles.method: At Six regions, take all six requested scenic photographs.

collectibles.name: Queen's Blood maximum rank
collectibles.method: At Regional opponents, reach the maximum Queen's Blood rank.

collectibles.name: Ultimate Party Animal
collectibles.method: At Gold Saucer side quest, complete every activity and finish the quest.

collectibles.name: Six PLAY ARTS boxes
collectibles.method: At Regional pickup sites, collect the Grasslands Rest Spot, Junon Sweeper, Corel Wheelie, Gongaga Buggy, Cosmo Tiny Bronco, and Nibel Shinra Box figures.

collectibles.name: Moogle Intel
collectibles.location: @loc{Grasslands, Junon, Corel, Gongaga, Cosmo Canyon, and Nibel}
collectibles.method: At Grasslands, Junon, Corel, Gongaga, Cosmo Canyon, and Nibel, complete all seven Moogle Emporiums, including both Corel challenges.

collectibles.name: Stuffed Stamp
collectibles.method: At Chapter 4 post-parade battles, keep all five Seventh Infantry troopers alive through the Roche fight.

collectibles.name: Stuffed Fat Moogle
collectibles.method: At Chapter 11 elevator, hit at least ten crates during the Cait Sith lift sequence.

collectibles.name: Gold Saucer GP exchanges
collectibles.method: At Gold Saucer prize shops, after earning the prerequisite awards, buy the nineteen Treasure Trove prizes with GP.

collectibles.name: Rufus Shinra cutout photo
collectibles.method: At Chapter 4 Larboard Junon, frame the posing infantry and Rufus cutout until the outline turns green, then take the photo.

achievements.description: Defeat Sephiroth in 3D Brawler.
achievements.sortReason: Placed in the route phase where its requirements can be completed efficiently.
achievements.summary: Complete all 36 side quests, unlock @enemy{Sephiroth} in 3D Brawler, and defeat him.

guide.context: Sephiroth is the final 3D Brawler opponent and does not appear until the full side-quest requirement is met. Pausing after each telegraph can make the dodge direction easier to read.

steps.text: Complete all 36 side quests to unlock Sephiroth's 3D Brawler challenge.
At @loc{Gold Saucer > Wonderment Square}, select Sephiroth in 3D Brawler, dodge every telegraphed strike, and deplete his health.

achievements.description: Play all six Piano Outreach Association songs well enough to receive remuneration.
achievements.sortReason: Placed in the route phase where its requirements can be completed efficiently.
achievements.summary: Earn A rank on six Piano Outreach songs, then report the results to @npc{Dorian}.

guide.context: Dorian stands beside the first five pianos. Aerith's Theme is awarded through My White-Haired Angel rather than found on a music stand.

steps.text: Earn @mechanic{A} on On Our Way at Crow's Nest, Tifa's Theme at Costa del Sol, and Barret's Theme at North Corel.
Earn @mechanic{A} on Cinco de Chocobo at Gongaga and Two Legs? Nothin' to It at Cosmo Canyon.
Complete @loc{My White-Haired Angel} in Nibel to receive Aerith's Theme, then earn @mechanic{A} on it.
Speak to @npc{Dorian} after all six A ranks are recorded.

achievements.description: Complete all bouts in Musclehead Colosseum.
achievements.sortReason: Placed in the route phase where its requirements can be completed efficiently.
achievements.summary: Clear every standard and postgame bout in @loc{Musclehead Colosseum}.

guide.context: Several bouts are added only after the story is finished, so an apparently complete Chapter 12 list is not the final list.

steps.text: Clear every available Musclehead Colosseum bout during Chapter 12.
Finish Chapter 14, return through Chapter Select, and clear every newly added bout until the menu shows all entries complete.

achievements.description: Win all chocobo races at the Gold Saucer.
achievements.sortReason: Placed in the route phase where its requirements can be completed efficiently.
achievements.summary: Win every chocobo race at the @loc{Gold Saucer}, including the side-quest-locked final race.

guide.context: Chapter 12 adds the late cups, and the final race is tied to the chocobo-racing side-quest progression.

steps.text: Win every available beginner, advanced, and Chapter 12 chocobo cup.
Complete the associated racing quest chain, unlock the final race, and finish first.

achievements.description: Complete all 36 side quests.
achievements.sortReason: Placed in the route phase where its requirements can be completed efficiently.
achievements.summary: Complete all 36 side quests, including the final Chapter 12 Gold Saucer quest.

guide.context: The last quest appears after the Chapter 12 boss only when the previous 35 quests and its required Gold Saucer activities, including Musclehead participation, are complete.

steps.text: Complete every green-icon quest in the Grasslands, Junon, Corel, Gongaga, Cosmo Canyon, and Nibel.
In Chapter 12, attempt the required Gold Saucer activities and clear the available prerequisite quests.
After the Chapter 12 boss, accept and finish the last Gold Saucer side quest so the Play Log shows 36/36.

achievements.description: Attain level 70 with a character.
achievements.sortReason: Placed in the route phase where its requirements can be completed efficiently.
achievements.summary: Reach character level 70 with the postgame party.

guide.context: The first clear unlocks high-experience Chapter Select and Combat Simulator options. New Game — Head Start begins at level 65 under patch 1.005.

steps.text: Complete Chapter 14 to unlock the postgame activity set.
Repeat high-level Chapter Select encounters or Combat Simulator challenges until the party reaches level 70.

achievements.description: Deal 300% or more damage to a staggered enemy.
achievements.sortReason: Placed in the route phase where its requirements can be completed efficiently.
achievements.summary: Raise one staggered enemy's damage multiplier to 300% with Tifa's stagger-extending abilities.

guide.context: Use a durable summon or boss and disable patch 1.005's 9,999-damage option so the target survives. Stop can freeze the stagger timer while multiplier gains continue.

steps.text: Put Tifa in the party, equip ATB support if available, and use @mechanic{Unbridled Strength} twice before staggering a durable target.
Fill the target's stagger gauge without killing it.
During stagger, spend Rise and Fall and Omnistrike, then repeatedly use @mechanic{True Strike} until the multiplier reaches 300%.

achievements.description: Master all weapon abilities and limit breaks, including those found in folios.
achievements.sortReason: Placed in the route phase where its requirements can be completed efficiently.
achievements.summary: Master all 49 weapon abilities and unlock every required non-blue folio ability and all seven folio limit breaks.

guide.context: Forty-three weapons are found normally or become purchasable after the story. Party Level 9 and sufficient manuscripts/SP are needed for every purple skill and yellow limit-break folio node; blue stat nodes do not count.

steps.text: Obtain Dragon Claws from Rank III of standard Desert Rush, Silver Collar from Rank III of Run Wild: Free-for-All, Fafnir Rifle from The Pursuit of Perfection, Crescent Sickle from Rank III of the first Glide de Chocobo course during Bonds of Trust, Gjallarhorn after delivering 45 Chocograss in Esoteric Secrets of the Elders, and Plumose Rod after all eight Lament of the Damned Shinra Manor simulations.
Equip every weapon and use its unique ability, meeting the listed Proficiency Bonus where practical, until all 49 abilities reach 100%.
Complete quests, relationship goals, minigames, and World Intel until Party Level reaches 9; collect enough manuscripts/SP for every character.
At each character's Folio, buy every non-blue ability node and all seven limit-break nodes.

achievements.description: Complete all chapters on Hard difficulty.
achievements.sortReason: Placed in the route phase where its requirements can be completed efficiently.
achievements.summary: Use postgame Chapter Select to complete Chapters 1–14 on Hard difficulty.

guide.context: Hard unlocks after the first clear and carries levels, equipment, materia, and quest progress. Items are disabled and MP recovery is restricted, so develop the party first; patch 1.005 progression assists remain optional.

steps.text: Complete Chapter 14 once on any available difficulty.
Open @mechanic{Chapter Select}, choose a chapter, and set @mechanic{Hard}.
Finish Chapters 1–14 on Hard; they may be cleared in any order, but every chapter must show a Hard clear.

achievements.description: Complete all of Chadley's combat simulations.
achievements.sortReason: Placed in the route phase where its requirements can be completed efficiently.
achievements.summary: Complete every required Chadley Combat Simulator challenge, including all Brutal and Legendary bouts.

guide.context: Regional Biological Intel unlocks are gated by assessed enemies and completed battles. Several final simulations also require the story clear, Pirate King's Treasure, Gilgamesh, and fully developed Enemy Skill materia.

steps.text: Reach the required assess/battle totals: Grasslands 16/24, Junon 10/15, Corel 25/38, Gongaga 14/20, Cosmo Canyon 15/22, and Nibel 16/24.
Complete the Biological Intel line through @loc{Know Thine Enemy} and fully level Enemy Skill materia.
Complete Pirate King's Treasure in Chapter 12/13, finish Chapter 14, complete every regional protorelic chain, and defeat Gilgamesh.
Return to Chadley through Chapter Select and clear every remaining Regional, Biological, Summon, Brutal, and Legendary simulation.
